player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''WorldChamp''') posted a [[Light]] [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit]] list on DeckTech in June 2001.

starting.card: You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed

description: This deck utilizes lots of interrupts and mains and podracing to win. This deck has won by +30 several times, and not lost yet.

notes: Posted 8 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (9)': Profit, Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol, Tatooine: Jabba's Palace, Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber, Podrace Prep, Boonta Eve Podrace, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Anakin's Podracer, K'lor'slug; these count toward the 60.

K'lor'slug is posted as 'K'lor Slug (The Camp vs. MKOS/Court)': it is the starting Effect, with The Camp started instead against Mos Eisley/Court decks (The Camp is posted under Effects as 'sometimes starting').

The posted list totals 59. The strategy says: 'I just counted my deck after writing the list and found only 59 cards, so I added an Orri. There is now and Orri in this deck.' Orrimaarko is added on the poster's word, making 60.
Light two-sided cards dested the Light pages: 'JP' = Tatooine: Jabba's Palace (Special Edition), 'AC' = Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber, Weapon Levitation = the Jabba's Palace interrupt.

Posted 'Jedi Luke' dested Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight; 'DOS' Daughter Of Skywalker; 'Luke's Stick' Luke's Lightsaber; 'Obi's Stick' Obi-Wan's Lightsaber; 'HotJedi' Honor Of The Jedi; 'Projection' Projection Of A Skywalker; 'Courage' Courage Of A Skywalker; 'Outskirts' Tatooine: City Outskirts; 'Obi's Hut' Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut.
